translationRepairs: Before he capped his years, the province appointed him Retainer of the Council; recommended as Filial-and-Incorrupt, he rose through Attendant of the Heir Apparent and Director of the Ministry of Justice Comparison Section to Registrar of the Pacification Army.

Before he capped his years, the province appointed him Retainer of the Council; recommended as Flourishing Talent (xiucai), he rose through Attendant of the Heir Apparent and Director of the Ministry of Justice Comparison Section to Registrar of the Pacification Army.
s0020 has 舉秀才, the recommendation category Flourishing Talent (xiucai); Filial-and-Incorrupt would require 孝廉, which is absent.
In Song times his grandfather Guan had served in the Ministry of Personnel; in the courtyard he planted a fine tree and said: "I am planting this for Xianzhi."
In Song times his grandfather Ji had served in the Ministry of Personnel; in the courtyard he planted a fine tree and said: "I am planting this for Xianzhi."
其祖覬之 names the grandfather 覬之; Guan is unsupported. Mandarin reading of 覬 is Ji, so Kai is still wrong; replace Guan with Ji.
In Song times his grandfather Guan had once served in the Ministry of Personnel; in the courtyard he planted a fine tree and told people: "I am planting this for Xianzhi."
In Song times his grandfather Ji had once served in the Ministry of Personnel; in the courtyard he planted a fine tree and told people: "I am planting this for Xianzhi."
Literal likewise misreads 覬之 as Guan; the personal name is Ji, not Kai or Guan.

At the beginning of Qi he was Director of the Ministry of Justice Comparison Section; Chu Yuan was Minister of Works and was on good terms with Jizhi, repeatedly making him Registrar of the Masters of Works and Minister of Works, entrusting him with bureau affairs.

At the beginning of Qi he was Director of the Ministry of Justice Comparison Section; Chu Yuan was Director of the Imperial Secretariat and was on good terms with Jizhi, repeatedly making him Registrar to the Minister of Works and Minister of Education, entrusting him with bureau affairs.
褚淵爲尚書令 makes Chu Yuan Director of the Imperial Secretariat, not 司空; 頻以爲司空司徒主簿 makes Jizhi registrar under the Minister of Works and Minister of Education.

When Yuan died, Minister of Works Wang Jian, because Yuan had utmost conduct, wished to posthumously title him Duke Wenxiao; Jizhi petitioned: "Wenxiao was Sima Daozi's posthumous title—I fear the man was not wholly good; better Wenjian."

When Yuan died, Director of the Imperial Secretariat Wang Jian, because Yuan had utmost conduct, wished to posthumously title him Duke Wenxiao; Jizhi petitioned: "Wenxiao was Sima Daozi's posthumous title—I fear the man was not wholly good; better Wenjian."
尚書令王儉 titles Wang Jian Director of the Imperial Secretariat; Minister of Works (司空) is not in this unit.
Birth and entering death, death and leaving life—reason treats them like day and night.
Birth and entering death—reason treats them like day and night.
夫出生入死，理均晝夜 has only the idiom 出生入死; the parallel "death and leaving life" is invented English.
At the beginning of Tianjian he was Friend of the Prince of Linchuan, then Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and assistant to the administrator of Danyang.
At the beginning of Tianjian he was Friend of the Prince of Linchuan, then Cadet of the Heir Apparent and assistant to the administrator of Danyang.
復爲太子中舍人 is Cadet of the Heir Apparent, not Junior Mentor (太子中庶子); drop the awkward parenthetical romanization while keeping the corrected office.
